description.value: Fuller Lake Arena is a municipal sports centre in Chemainus operated by North Cowichan Parks and Recreation. The multi-sport facility serves the local community and is part of the broader North Cowichan recreation network. For touring cyclists, it may function as a recognizable landmark and potential rest stop along Fuller Lake Road.

Without any descriptive content about the arena's actual amenities, all required criteria and optional amenities must be null.
